alkonost: An alkonost: the head and arms of a woman joined to the body, wings and legs of a great bird, perched gripping a bare branch. BRILLIANT MULTICOLOURED PLUMAGE - gold, deep red, teal and violet layered across the wings and tail. Long flowing red hair and a calm human face, MODESTLY DRESSED with a feathered mantle covering her chest and shoulders. The feathered bird body begins at the waist. ITS FEET ARE THE CRITICAL DETAIL: each yellow bird foot has EXACTLY TWO TOES AND TWO BLACK TALONS AND NO MORE - one toe pointing forward and one toe pointing backward, gripping the branch between them like a pair of pincers. TWO TALONS PER FOOT, never three, never four. Count them: two. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
apep: Apep, an enormous dark serpent, drawn as ONE SINGLE CLEAN CONTINUOUS BODY in a simple readable S-CURVE - the body must never cross over itself, never pass through itself, and never tangle into knots. One head at one end, a tapering tail at the other, and the whole length traceable from head to tail without ambiguity. Glinting dark scales with a faint red sheen. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
arcticfox: An adult Arctic fox standing squarely on all four legs in profile, with a SOLID UNBROKEN OPAQUE SILHOUETTE and no gaps or holes in its outline or coat, a thick white winter coat, short rounded ears, a short blunt muzzle and a very bushy tail. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
